The '''AA-9 Freighter-Liner''', also known as the '''Botajef Freighter-Liner''' or '''AA-9 Coruscant Starfreighter''', was a [[starship]] produced by [[Botajef Shipyards]] which first brought the small shipbuilding concern to galactic prominence. Initially conceived as a [[freighter]], it went on to be used as a [[refugee]] [[transport]] and, during the [[Clone Wars]], served as a [[Troop transport|troopship]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic]].

==Characteristics==
The AA-9 Freighter-Liner, also referred to as the AA-9 Coruscant freighter, was a [[freighter]] manufactured by [[Botajef Shipyards]] that could reach speeds of 420 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] and was 390 [[meter]]s in length. It had a passenger capacity of 30,000 and had over three [[Standard month|months]]' worth of emergency consumables on board. It was equipped with a Class 4 [[hyperdrive]], three powerful [[engine]]s, a starboard and port boarding area, multi-deck accommodation,<ref name="Starfighters" /> several cafeterias, and various [[service droid]]s.<ref name="AA-9 Coruscant freighter">{{Databank|aa-9-coruscant-freighter|AA-9 Coruscant freighter}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:AA9CoruscantStarfreighter-MF50.png|thumb|left|300px|The starboard profile of an AA-9 Coruscant Starfreighter]]
AA-9 Freighter-Liners, originally built to haul cargo,<ref name="Starfighters" /> were active as [[transport]]s during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. In [[22 BBY]], an AA-9 Freighter-Liner, the ''[[Jendirian Valley]]'', was responsible for transporting [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], along with her [[Jedi]] escort [[Anakin Skywalker]], back to her [[homeworld]] of [[Naboo]] after the failure of an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt against her]].<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Refugee Relief Movement]] utilized AA-9s as support vessels, transporting [[refugee]]s from [[planet]]s that fell under the control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Grand Army of the Republic|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] also utilized AA-9 Freighter-Liners during the war to transport cargo and [[clone trooper]]s, and their location on Coruscant made them ideal for such operations.<ref name="Starfighters" /> The model's extensive use during the war brought Botajef Shipyards to prominence in the galactic shipbuilding industry, allowing the company to branch out into the [[SS-54 assault ship|military starship market]].<ref name="Knights of Fate">''[[Knights of Fate]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The AA-9 Freighter-Liner first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="Episode II" /> and was later identified as the AA-9 Coruscant freighter in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]].<ref name="AA-9 Coruscant freighter" />
